description: issue #844: the EXECUTE-mode twin of geometry/check/arity-paren-axes-too-many. `axes` takes no arguments, so `(axes 50)` raises `ol-too-many-inputs` at `stage: "runtime"` with the same callable/expected/actual params and the same callee span the checker reports at `stage: "semantic"` — the two stages agreeing on one call.
